title: hieracium carpathicum subsp. truncatum
intro: Hieracium carpathicum subsp. truncatum, commonly known as Carpathian hawkweed, is a plant species that belongs to the dandelion-like plants in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include reducing inflammation, treating wounds, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium carpathicum subsp. truncatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties and may contribute to its potential health benefits.
